output.answer: Lenovo Group Limited (HKEX: 992) does not have a single parent company in the strict sense — it is a publicly listed company. Its largest and controlling shareholder is Legend Holdings Corporation (联想控股股份有限公司), a Chinese investment holding company that held approximately 32.04% of Lenovo's issued shares as of March 31, 2026. Legend Holdings is therefore commonly described as Lenovo's parent company; it was formed by the Chinese Academy of Sciences, and Lenovo is its best-known associate.
caveats: Strictly speaking, Lenovo is not a wholly owned subsidiary: it is a Hong Kong-listed company (HKEX: 992) and no single entity holds a majority. Legend Holdings' ~32% stake makes it the controlling/largest shareholder, which is why it is commonly called Lenovo's parent company; an HKEX substantial-shareholder notice records Lenovo's 'listed parent' as N/A.
The 32.04% figure is as of March 31, 2026 (Lenovo's fiscal year-end); the stake may have changed since that date.
